purpose: Teach: 織り/格子/三輪/面影/根強い/坊さん/悔い/実体験

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、織りものの、絶対、教室、絶対、通おうかな
lines.en: Sho, would you ever think about coming to a weaving class with me?
lines.style: Warm, inviting lilt. Gentle warmth drawing him in. Soft emphasis on the question itself, like she's offering a gift and hoping he'll take it. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お家の窓、絶対、格子柄、絶対、お洒落だね
lines.en: Mei-sis, the lattice pattern on your house windows is so pretty.
lines.style: Bright, observant wonder. Genuine enthusiasm — the kind only a six-year-old can muster without performance. Direct eye contact energy. Quick, natural pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、三輪車、絶対、まだ、絶対、覚えてる?メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、懐かしい
lines.en: Sho, do you still remember when I had that tricycle? It feels like so long ago now.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic turn inward. Breath shifts toward wistfulness. Slight pause before the second part — she's traveling back in time as she speaks. Gentle, almost wondering aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お母さんに、絶対、面影、絶対、似てるって、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、言ってたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa said you look like Mom sometimes.
lines.style: Quietly perceptive, stated as simple fact. No performance — just noticing something true. Soft delivery, like he's sharing a secret observation. Pause-weight on the resemblance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんのお店の、本気で、絶対、根強い、絶対、ファン、絶対、いてくださるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: There are customers at my shop who've been loyal to me for a long time, Sho.
lines.style: Quiet pride beneath the words. Warmth and slight vulnerability — she's sharing something that matters. Steady, grounded tone. The word 'loyal' lands with gentle weight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 近所のお寺に、本気で、絶対、坊さん、絶対、優しい、絶対、人が、絶対、いるよ、メイ姉さん
lines.en: There's a kind monk at the temple nearby, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation offered gently. The pacing is casual, like he's sharing something he noticed. No strain for significance — it just is. Soft, present.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、学生時代、絶対、もっと、絶対、勉強、絶対、しておけば、絶対、よかったって、絶対、悔い、絶対、残ってるわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sometimes I wish I'd studied harder back in school. I have some regret about that, Sho.
lines.style: Reflective, turning inward. Thoughtful pause before the admission. Honest vulnerability — not seeking reassurance, just speaking truth to someone she trusts. Slightly lower energy, contemplative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、実体験、絶対、ぼく、絶対、聞きたいよ
lines.en: I'd really like to tell you about some things I've learned, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Soft, genuine eagerness. Not demanding — requesting. The warmth is in the simplicity. Natural pacing, slight lean-forward energy. Sincere without trying.
